newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Feb actual foreign investment up 1.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Feb actual foreign investment up 1.6 pct.

text.p: China attracted actual foreign investment totalling $4.64 billion in the first two months of 1997, up 1.6 percent from the year-ago period, State Statistical Bureau spokesman Ye Zhen said on Friday.
Direct foreign investment inched up a year-on-year 0.37 percent to $4.55 billion in the first two months, Ye said. He gave no further details.
